name: Ovčar 2026
description: Kablar Skyrace is a mountain race held in the spectacular Ovčar-Kablar Gorge, starting and finishing in Ovčar Banja. The 22.4 km race, with 1,600 metres of cumulative elevation gain, runs through forested terrain, technically challenging rocky sections and over two Kablar peaks, offering runners a challenge and beautiful panoramic views of the West Morava River and the surrounding mountains. The race is part of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia’s national series and is intended for both experienced runners and recreational runners who want to enjoy nature and test their abilities. The course is certified and counts toward the Mountaineering Association of Serbia series; appropriate equipment is mandatory, and prizes are provided for the top finishers. The race is part of the national mountain-running series and marks the 75th anniversary of the “Kablar” Mountaineering Club.

The courses pass over the peaks of Ljujaš (1,269 m), Orlić (1,235 m), Jelova Gora (1,311 m), Bandera-Tornik (1,496 m), and Liska (1,346 m)
The race passes through unspoiled nature and lesser-known parts of Zlatibor
additional: The race headquarters are at the primary school in the village of Jablanica. The race is part of the National Mountain Running Series, which includes five rounds for seniors and three races for juniors. Participation requires a validated PSS competition booklet or a medical certificate. Senior scoring includes bonus points for the national championship and ultra-trail races. The Mountaineering Association of Serbia is a member of the World Mountain Running Association (WMRA). Participants can expect challenging mountain courses, and the race is part of a wider national series promoting mountain running in Serbia.

name: Nebeski visovi 2026
description: The "Tornik" Mountaineering Club from Čajetina and the Mountaineering Association of Serbia invite you to take part in the unforgettable "Nebeski visovi" skyrace in the fairytale setting of Zlatibor, in the village of Jablanica. This race is the first event of the year in the Mountaineering Association of Serbia’s national mountain running series and is intended for athletes, recreational runners, and nature lovers. The race offers two loop courses, starting and finishing by the school in the center of Jablanica, and passing through areas with spectacular views. Participants can choose between the 21 km red course with 1,400 m of cumulative ascent and the 10 km blue course with 500 m of ascent.
course_highlights: Red course: 21 km, 1,400 m of cumulative ascent
Blue course: 10 km, 500 m of ascent
Loop courses start and finish by the school in Jablanica and pass through areas with beautiful views
additional: Race packet pickup on race day by the school in Jablanica, from 8:00 to 9:45. Red course start at 10:00; blue course start at 10:15. Categories include overall men’s and women’s, team, junior, senior, and veteran categories. Time limits are 4h30min for the red course and 3h for the blue course in the Mountaineering Association of Serbia competition, and 6h and 4h, respectively, in the open competition. Terrain includes mountain trails with significant climbs; on-site registration; categories for different age groups and team competition categories.

name: Somborski polumaraton
description: The Sombor Half Marathon is a traditional race held in Sombor, featuring a new course through beautiful parts of the city. The event brings together many runners from Serbia and abroad, promoting a healthy lifestyle and recreational running. The organizers strive to make the race well organized and enjoyable for all participants, with special attention to the atmosphere and socializing. The race is part of the rich program of activities of the Somaraton Athletics and Recreation Club, which has fostered Sombor’s long-standing running tradition.
course_highlights: New course through Somborica
Organized transportation for participants
Medal for all participants
additional: Organized transportation to Somborica is available for participants; the contact person is Milan Kovačić. The celebration of ARK Somaraton’s 16th anniversary is part of the accompanying activities. Runners receive a medal for participating. The club has around 65 members, with active training sessions and support for runners of all levels. The event also includes organized city tours, cultural activities, and support during the race, and is open to all age groups.

name: Mokra Gora Trail
description: Mokra Gora Trail is a new regional hiking trail that runs across Mount Mokra Gora, connecting Montenegro, Kosovo* and Serbia. The trail is part of the Via Dinarica network and offers a unique opportunity for adventure tourism and exploration of the Balkans’ unspoiled nature. It was developed with the support of the Institute for Territorial Economic Development and the Regional Cooperation Council, with the aim of promoting cross-border tourism and preserving the region’s natural beauty. The trail is known for its Via Ferrata attractions, which offer exciting experiences for hikers and nature lovers.
course_highlights: The trail runs across Mount Mokra Gora, connecting three countries: Montenegro, Kosovo* and Serbia
It is part of the Via Dinarica network, known for its unspoiled nature and mountain landscapes
Via Ferrata sections offer adventure opportunities for hikers
additional: The trail is part of the Via Dinarica cross-border project and was developed to promote sustainable tourism and improve infrastructure. No race price or registration details are listed, indicating that the focus is on the hiking trail rather than a competition. The contact organization is the Regional Cooperation Council, headquartered in Sarajevo. The project is linked to the development of regional hiking trails, including Via Ferrata, GPS mapping and the installation of signage, with the aim of promoting sustainable tourism and cooperation in the region.

name: Dragutin Tomašević
description: The Dragutin Tomašević Memorial Athletics Race is held in the village of Bistrica near Petrovac na Mlavi in memory of the first Serbian Olympian. This 21st anniversary race brings together runners of all ages and categories, offering opportunities to compete in the men’s and women’s events and across age groups. Participants receive chipped bib numbers and “Joma” Dry Fit T-shirts, while the organizers provide transportation and a celebratory dinner. The race is known for its tradition and support from the local community, creating a welcoming atmosphere for all runners.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the village of Bistrica, Petrovac na Mlavi
Chipped personalized bib number and “Joma” Dry Fit sports T-shirt
Transportation from the registration center to the race start and a celebratory dinner at the Olimpik swimming pools
additional: The participant package includes transportation from Belgrade (Arena) to Petrovac na Mlavi and back, with a tour leader. It is limited to 50 competitors who pay first. Participants receive a 50% discount on a day ticket to Ždrelo Spa. Special accommodation benefits are available for race participants at the Olimpic swimming pool. The race is part of the annual events honoring Dragutin Tomašević, with organization that includes timing, promotion, T-shirts, and medals for participants.

name: Ivanjica Trail
description: Ivanjica Trail is a unique trail race in Serbia, bringing together runners of different fitness levels across several courses of varying distances and difficulty. The races take place in the beautiful natural landscapes of Ivanjica and Golija, with viewpoints, meadows, forests and streams, offering an unforgettable running experience in nature. The Golija PREMIUM race, starting at the summit of Golija, and the two-day ULTRA 66K stage race, which connects three mountains and offers a challenge for experienced runners, are particular highlights. The organizers provide race packs, refreshments, lunch, transport and accommodation for participants, creating a welcoming and supportive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes through spectacular landscapes featuring viewpoints, clearings and meadows
Race starts at elevations of 800 to 1833 meters above sea level
Electronic timing and staffed aid stations
additional: Free transport is provided for the Golija PREMIUM 29K race from Ivanjica to the start and from Kovilj back. ULTRA 66K is a two-day stage race with overnight accommodation at a school in Kovilj, four meals, six aid stations and a gathering around a campfire. The first ULTRA 66K stage starts at 11h, and the second at 09h the following day. The race pack includes a race number, finisher’s medal, refreshments and lunch. Multiple distances, a two-day event, an available list of registered participants, technically challenging routes, electronic timing, and race packs with medals and meals.

name: ONERUN 2026
description: One Run is an international race taking place for the eighth consecutive year, simultaneously across multiple countries and continents. The event is known for having been entered in the Guinness World Records twice as the world’s largest half marathon with a synchronized start. The race is open to everyone, with four distances available, and promotes health, accessibility, and community through sport and outdoor activities. This year, we are running in Veliko Gradište, Serbia, on May 23, with the goal of taking part in a new Guinness World Record attempt in Serbia for the first time.
course_highlights: Four distances: 1 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km
Synchronized start across multiple countries and continents
Event with two Guinness World Records for the largest half marathon with a synchronized start
additional: Registration is at Žitni trg in Veliko Gradište from 08:00 to 11:30 in the tent. The race pack includes a race bib with a chip, sponsor gifts, live results, and a diploma in PDF format. The race program includes a warm-up at 12:45, the start of the 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km races at 13:30, and the awards ceremony at 15:30. The event features races of different distances, is open to all ages, and race packs and medals are available to participants. It takes place in the center of Veliko Gradište, with morning registration and afternoon races.

name: Trail trka Tibuzde 2026
description: 1. Tibužde Trail is a trail race held in the village of Tibužde, near Vranje. The race offers two different distances, 27 km and 7 km, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy challenging terrain and the beauty of nature. The race starts at 7 a.m., and the event runs until 5 p.m., creating a great atmosphere for all running and nature enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Natural terrain around the village of Tibužde
Two distances: 27 km and 7 km
Views and challenging terrain
additional: The race runs from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. Terrain: mountainous. Registration: online. Categories: multiple, including a children's race. After the race, there is a get-together with lunch and music.

name: Tour de Fruška
distance_verbose: 59 km, 39 km, Polumaraton, 15 km, 7 km, 2 km, 1 km
description: Tour de Fruška is one of the region’s most attractive sporting events, held in the beautiful setting of Fruška Gora in Vrdnik. The event brings together sport, nature and tourism, offering participants a unique experience of cycling through unspoiled nature and beautiful landscapes. It draws cycling and active-holiday enthusiasts, promoting a healthy lifestyle and Vojvodina’s tourism potential.
course_highlights: Ride through Fruška Gora National Park
Beautiful landscapes and unspoiled nature
A variety of cycling trails and terrain
additional: The organizer is the Tourism Organization of Vojvodina. The event is held in Vrdnik, within Fruška Gora National Park. It promotes the combination of sport, nature and tourism in the region. Participants and visitors can enjoy a local-products market, activities for children and the promotion of a healthy lifestyle. Admission for visitors is free, while prices vary for the different competitive disciplines.

name: Ozren i Devica 2026
description: The Devica–Ozren hiking trip, organized by PSK Pobeda, takes participants up Mount Devica, one of the most beautiful and northernmost mountains in the Balkans. The trail passes through lush vegetation and limestone formations with numerous caves, including an ascent to Soko Grad and the Golem Kamen viewpoint, and finishes along a forest trail toward Ozren and Ripaljka Waterfall. The trip lasts one day, departing from Belgrade in the early morning and returning in the evening. Participants must have a Planinarski savez Srbije membership book stamped for 2026 and appropriate hiking equipment.
course_highlights: Ascent of Mount Devica, with lush vegetation and limestone formations
Visit to Marko Polo Cave and ascent to Soko Grad
Golem Kamen viewpoint and forest trail toward Ozren and Ripaljka Waterfall
additional: Departure from Nebojšina Street at 06:00. The planned return to Belgrade is around 22:00–22:30. Participants must bring a jacket, a light hat, lightweight gloves, a raincoat, high-top hiking boots, gaiters, trekking poles, a change of clothes, a flashlight, their own first-aid kit, energy bars or nuts, magnesium for muscle cramps, and at least 1.5–2 L of water. There is no water along part of the trail. Lunch will be organized after the ascent, or participants may bring food in their backpacks. Participants must have a hiking membership book stamped for 2026. Equipment should include a jacket, hat, gloves, high-top hiking boots, trekking poles, a flashlight, first aid, food, and water.

name: Serbia EPIC MIONICA #3
description: Serbia EPIC MIONICA #3 is an exciting series of races held in Mionica, offering a range of distances for runners of different levels. The races include mountain and cycling marathons, as well as shorter courses, all set in the beautiful natural surroundings of Stara Planina. This event attracts nature and sports enthusiasts, offering challenging and scenic routes. You are welcome to take part and enjoy the unique atmosphere and sporting spirit.
course_highlights: A variety of courses from 7 km to 60 km
Mountain and cycling marathons on Stara Planina
Beautiful natural landscapes and challenging terrain

name: Stazama Vuka Karadžića
description: The Vuk Karadžić Trails is a 25 km circular race with a total elevation gain of 1,000 metres. The course starts at Vuk’s Memorial House and winds through the shade of the centuries-old Monastery Forests, past forest streams and waterfalls, to the 13th-century Tronoša Monastery. It then passes through Mala Tronoša and Lisina to Zajača, from where the Monastery Candles Trail leads to Velika Bobija and the Miličin Konak ethnographic complex, before returning to Tršić and Vuk’s house, where the finish line is located. The race offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the region’s natural beauty and cultural and historical landmarks.
course_highlights: A 25 km circular course with 1,000 m of total elevation gain
Runs through the centuries-old Monastery Forests and past forest streams and waterfalls
Visits the 13th-century Tronoša Monastery and the Miličin Konak ethnographic complex
additional: A trail race focused on nature and cultural heritage. Participation is part of an international competition, and the race is intended for a wide range of runners.

name: Kros Trka Carica
description: The Carica Cross-Country Race is a traditional outdoor race held in Mali Stapar, bringing together runners of all ages, from children to competitors over seventy. The main race is 6.4 km long, preceded by children’s races with around forty participants. The event celebrates the traditions of sport, friendship, and spending time outdoors, and the organizers invite everyone to take part and enjoy this sporting event. The race is a prelude to the Friendship Race held in Kula, continuing the tradition of sport and community.
course_highlights: A 6.4 km main race in the outdoors
Children’s races with around 40 participants
A race in the natural surroundings of Mali Stapar
additional: Participants ranged in age from elementary school children to competitors over 70. The race is part of a sporting tradition and a prelude to larger sporting events in the region, such as the Friendship Race in Kula. It takes place in natural surroundings, with a focus on promoting a healthy lifestyle and sporting camaraderie among participants of different age groups.

name: Humanitarna IT trka „Štafeta srcem”
price_range: 8.000 dinara po timu (1.600 dinara po članu)
description: The charity IT race “Relay with Heart” will take place on June 5, 2026, at Niš Fortress. The event brings together the IT community and running enthusiasts in a charitable atmosphere, promoting solidarity and support through sport. The race is an opportunity to socialize, lead an active lifestyle, and give back to the community in the fortress’s beautiful setting.
course_highlights: The race takes place at historic Niš Fortress
A charitable atmosphere and spirit of community
Bringing the IT community together through sport
additional: Registration is open, and all proceeds will be donated to Nurdor to improve accommodation facilities for parents of children with cancer. The event also includes a post-race music gathering in the garden of the Mountaineers’ Lodge.

name: Dušan Milošević Memorial Trail
description: The Dušan Milošević Memorial Trail is a race held in honor of Dušan Milošević, the first Serbian Olympian, and follows the most beautiful trails of Rudnik. The race is dedicated to his courage and perseverance, with the aim of honoring his legacy and the Serbian spirit through running. There are three courses: the fast, shorter Vihor course; the more demanding Rudnik course, with steep climbs and descents; and the non-competitive Domaćinska course for those who want to enjoy nature. The race is an opportunity to celebrate history, courage, and togetherness.
course_highlights: The Vihor course runs above Stragari, with views of Bukulja, Kosmaj, Avala, and the Ramać heights
The Rudnik course follows genuine trail paths and forest roads, with steep climbs and descents
There are 2 aid stations with food and drinks on the Vihor course, and 4 on the Rudnik course
additional: The Domaćinska course is a non-competitive event for those who do not want to race, and the race takes place on June 6. It is organized by the “Dušan Milošević - First Serbian Olympian” Association as a tribute to his courage and place in history. Three courses: 5 km Domaćinska (non-competitive), start and finish in Stragari, support organization, safe conditions, and a sporting and recreational character.

name: Kup Fruške Gore 2026
description: Kup Fruške Gore 2026 is a traditional sporting, competitive and recreational event held on Fruška Gora. The races cover a range of routes, including an ultra extreme marathon, an ultra marathon, a medium eastern marathon and novice routes, with varying levels of difficulty and distance. The event brings together runners from Serbia and abroad, offering challenges on Fruška Gora’s old trails and an opportunity to enjoy nature and the spirit of sport. The organizers also provide organized transport to the start, as well as extensive support throughout the event.
course_highlights: Ultra extreme marathon with 5 ITRA points
Medium eastern marathon with 3 ITRA points
Novice routes with 1–2 ITRA points
additional: Organized transport to the marathon start from Novi Sad is available from 6 a.m. on Saturday. On-site registration for the FUN routes is available at Popovica on Saturday. Race packs are collected before the race. The event is supported by numerous patrons and sponsors. It includes various sporting challenges and outdoor activities, with opportunities for both recreational runners and competitors. Details about registration and programs will be available soon.

name: Serbia EPIC VRNJAČKA BANJA #4
description: The UCI XCO race in Andrevlje is an exciting competition bringing together elite and junior riders in men’s and women’s categories. Held in front of the Ceptor Hotel in the beautiful setting of Andrevlje, it lasts four days, offering a fantastic atmosphere and intense competition. Riders can expect electronic timing, fully marked courses, and a generous race package with a T-shirt, medal, and refreshments on the course. This is an event that combines sporting passion with Serbia’s natural beauty.
course_highlights: Fully marked course with GPS navigation
Refreshment stations on the course and at the finish
Electronic timing and a chip-equipped race number
additional: The race package includes a chip-equipped race number, electronic timing, an official race T-shirt for registrations received by 15.03.2026., a finisher medal, on-site support from the OTIS team, 3 professional photographers with free photos, a downloadable GPS track, and online results. The race time limit is 3 hours. Race-pack collection is from 09:00 to 11:30, and the awards ceremony is at 15:00. Participation includes electronic timing, bike washing, medical support, and parking; registration is open; the event lasts four days and features different races.

name: Village Trail
description: Village Trail 2026 is the third edition of the race, held in Višnjica, on the outskirts of Belgrade, on June 7, 2026. The race combines sport, nature, and adventure, with two courses winding through beautiful landscapes, including a viewpoint overlooking the Danube and Belgrade. The start and finish are at Dunavska Terasa restaurant, and the event is suitable for experienced runners and beginners. An entertainment program is provided for children and families, while runners can look forward to support from volunteers and an after-run party.
course_highlights: The course passes by the Church of St. Nicholas, built in 1842
Views of the Danube and Belgrade from a viewpoint
The course passes by the protected habitat of the European bee-eater
additional: The race pack includes a race number with a timing chip, an official Village Trail T-shirt, and a finisher's medal for everyone who completes the race within the time limit. Professional race photos and a detailed plan will be sent by email before the race. A special entertainment program is provided for children and families, and runners can enjoy the after-run party. Participation includes medals, T-shirts, and organizational support, and the race is intended for fans of trail running and nature.

name: Stara Planina 2026

description: Stara Planina Skiing 2026 is a four-day winter program offering skiing, sledding, walks, and socializing amid the unspoiled nature of Stara Planina. Enjoy the thrills and beautiful scenery at the Babin Zub ski resort, with more than 13 kilometers of groomed trails of varying difficulty, including a freeride trail and an artificial snowmaking system. The program is for skiers and winter-sports enthusiasts, with departures from Belgrade and Niš and accommodation at Ždrma Inn. If there is not enough snow, hiking tours are organized, making the event accessible to nature lovers and those seeking an active getaway.
course_highlights: Babin Zub ski resort, with 13+ km of groomed trails of varying difficulty
The Konjarnik four-seater chairlift and Serbia’s first gondola at Jabučko Ravnište
A freeride trail and an artificial snowmaking system
additional: Departure from Belgrade at 17:00, with a possible pickup in Niš. Transfers to the ski resort take place in the morning at 8:30 or 9:30, depending on the accommodation. If there is not enough snow, hiking tours are organized. Accommodation at Ždrma Inn in rooms with 3–5 beds. Activities on the slopes until 16:00 each day. A 4-day/3-night ski trip with transport from Belgrade and Niš, accommodation options, ski activities and lessons, as well as the option of hiking tours if snowfall is insufficient.

name: Sunrise Marathon
location: Bačka Palanka, South Bačka District, Serbia
description: The Sunrise Marathon in Bačka Palanka is an event that supports the mission of the Sunrise Association, an organization that provides free summer day camps for children with cancer and their siblings. Runners are invited to join Team Sunrise and help bring joy and happiness back to children facing this illness through running and fundraising. By taking part in the race, participants have the opportunity to support unique programs and camps that bring smiles and hope to children around the world.
course_highlights: Enjoy a drive through the beautiful natural surroundings of Bačka Palanka
A choice of race distances (marathon, half marathon, 10K, 5K)
Support charitable causes for children with cancer
additional: Race participants can join Team Sunrise and receive a personalized fundraising page, a Team Sunrise T-shirt, and tools for collecting donations. Registration is handled directly through the race organizer, and participants arrange their own travel. Charity race bibs are limited and allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. Participation is often linked to charitable donations and fundraising for children with cancer; registration details and dates are available from the organizer.

name: Vidra Gradac Trail
description: Vidra Gradac Trail offers a unique running experience along the Gradac River, known for its untouched nature and crystal-clear water. The course runs through a canyon rich in wildlife and varied terrain, including forest trails, rocky banks, and stream crossings. This race combines natural splendor and adventure, making it ideal for runners who want to experience trail running at its most scenic. It takes place in Valjevo, Serbia, and is part of the West Serbia Trails series, which connects the mountains, rivers, and valleys of western Serbia.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Gradac River canyon, with its crystal-clear water
Varied terrain: forest trails, rocky banks, and stream crossings
Abundant wildlife and the natural beauty of an untouched landscape
additional: The race is part of the West Serbia Trails series, which connects the mountains, rivers, and valleys of western Serbia. It is inspired by the otter, a symbol of vitality and playfulness. No specific information was found about the race start time, registration, or prices. This trail race features varied terrain along the Gradac River and focuses on natural beauty and adventure. It takes place in June 2026.

name: 9. Vidra Gradac Trail
description: Vidra Gradac Trail is part of the West Serbia Trails series of events held in the beautiful natural landscapes of western Serbia. The race offers 10 km and 19 km courses that run alongside the Gradac River, one of the cleanest rivers in Europe, known for its unspoiled nature. Participants have the opportunity to experience Serbia’s unspoiled nature, running through forested and mountainous areas that are often accessible only to pedestrians. This event is ideal for running and nature enthusiasts who want to test their abilities in an authentic setting.
course_highlights: 10 km and 19 km courses
Running alongside the Gradac River with its clear waters
Unspoiled nature and mountain scenery accessible only to pedestrians
additional: The organizers provide refreshments along the course, with drinks and snacks at several points. Comfortable sportswear suitable for running in nature is recommended. The event is part of a series of races and hiking tours held throughout the year in western Serbia. Trail running and hiking in the scenic landscapes of western Serbia, with experiences of local culture and nature.

name: Ultramaraton Palić
price_range: 50 € donacija po disciplini, startnina 50 € za strane državljane, smeštaj od 30-50 € po noći
description: The Palić Ultramarathon is a national and international ultramarathon championship held in Palić and organized by the Ultramarathon Association of Serbia. The event features several disciplines: 6-, 12- and 24-hour races, as well as 50 km and 100 km races, with the start and finish at the Great Terrace. The competition is open to all ultramarathoners who follow the rules, with participants competing in the overall and age categories. Alongside the competitive spirit, the event offers a well-stocked aid station, a communal lunch and prizes for the top finishers, as well as special prizes for the youngest and oldest participants.
course_highlights: 6-, 12- and 24-hour races
50 km and 100 km races
Start and finish at the Great Terrace in Palić
additional: Accommodation is arranged in hotels and motels, with a shared tent also available for competitors who do not need overnight accommodation. A well-stocked aid station is available during the race, followed by a communal lunch for all participants. Prizes are awarded in the overall and age categories, including special prizes for the youngest and oldest participants. The event includes recreational training sessions, competitions and the promotion of ultramarathoning in the region, and takes place in June 2026.

name: Trka prijateljstva Kula
location: Kula, South Bačka District, Vojvodina, Serbia
description: The Friendship Race in Kula is a traditional event held since 2009 that promotes sport, friendship, family values, and recreation. The race brings together amateur, recreational, and professional runners from the region and beyond, creating a unique running community. Over the years, it has become the largest sporting event in the municipality of Kula, with more than 6,000 participants and a total of 34,000 kilometers run. The organizers continuously improve the event, prizes, and organization to make the race even better and more appealing to all participants.
course_highlights: Promotes sport and friendship
Large-scale regional event
Long-standing tradition since 2009
additional: The Friendship Race is the largest sporting event in the municipality of Kula and brings together runners from across the region. The organizers are committed to continuously improving the event and the running community. The Kula Running League is a related activity that brings runners together throughout the year and has a significant history and number of participants. Participants can run on a 5 km or 10 km course, with special safety measures in place during the COVID-19 pandemic. The organization also includes support with registration locations and transport from Belgrade.

name: ISKRA Trail Kosmaj

tiers.description: Uplatom startnine do 19.5. osiguravate svoj učesnički paket sa majicom

description: Iskra Kosmaj Trail is a trail race held on the beautiful Kosmaj mountain, giving participants the chance to enjoy dense forests and breathtaking views. The race is a great opportunity for an outing and socializing in the race village located in the start and finish area. Three distances are available, and the race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers of all ages; participants under 18 need parental consent. The organizer guarantees safety and a great atmosphere, and participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt if they register on time.
course_highlights: Trails through the dense forests of Kosmaj mountain
Beautiful viewpoints and natural landscapes
A race village with food, drinks, and music in the start and finish area
additional: The total number of participants is limited to 1,000. Race packs can be collected in Belgrade ten days before the race. Entry fees are non-refundable, but participation can be gifted or transferred to the following year. Changing and leaving belongings is at participants’ own discretion. The race is also open to walkers and Nordic walkers. Registration is open until June 10, 2025. The start is scheduled for 08:00 in the morning, and the race takes place near the monument to the Kosmaj Partisan Detachment. Participants will be able to enjoy nature and visit local attractions after the race.

name: Noćni maraton
location: Novi Sad, South Bačka District, Serbia
organizer: Tletsko rekreativni klub “Fruška gora” – Novi Sad
description: The Novi Sad Night Marathon is one of the most attended races in Serbia and a unique nighttime athletics and recreational event. The main race is the 42 km marathon, which demands dedication and mental strength, while the half marathon attracts the most participants and brings the special energy of a night race. There is also a mini-marathon for children and Nordic walking, making the event accessible to all ages and fitness levels. The race has become a tradition and a source of pride for Novi Sad, with carefully organized race packages and a rich experience on the course and after the race.
course_highlights: A night race through the streets of Novi Sad
A 42.2 km marathon as the main event
A half marathon with mass participation and a unique atmosphere
additional: Race packs can be collected the day before and on race day. Participants receive a technical shirt, a bib with a chip, a finisher’s medal, on-course refreshments, and a post-race massage. Registration is available only through the trka.rs portal; registration on race day is not allowed. Participants under 18 cannot enter the marathon, and parental consent is required for the mini-marathon and half marathon. The event includes several race distances and a Nordic walk, with registration through the trka.rs platform. It is scheduled for late June 2026, with registration and program details available on the official website.

name: Mala Sveta Gora
description: The Mala Sveta Gora running race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Ovčar Banja and offers three running categories: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km). The race is known for its challenging course through nature, offering runners a unique experience and the opportunity to compete over different distances. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take advantage of promotional prices and take part in this sporting event, which brings together runners from across the region.
course_highlights: Routes through the natural surroundings of Ovčar Banja
Three categories: 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km
A challenging and varied running route
additional: The event is connected with local cultural and historical landmarks and natural beauty, and takes place within Ovčar Banja’s broader tourism and sporting setting.

name: TORNIK RACE 2026
description: Tornik Race is a unique running adventure on Zlatibor that combines adrenaline-fueled challenges with nature conservation. The races are designed for all ages and ability levels, with 6 km, 15 km and 25 km courses, as well as children’s races. Participants can enjoy Tornik’s natural beauty, test their endurance and contribute to protecting the environment through the Plogging Race. The organizers aim to build a community of passionate runners and nature lovers, offering an unforgettable experience and a healthy sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Courses through Tornik’s natural landscapes in three distances: 6 km, 15 km and 25 km
A Plogging Race combining running with cleaning up nature
Children’s OCR races with obstacles suited to different age groups
